notes.title: November update patch
notes.notes:
This patch fixes some bugs in the game:

-Some exits that gave problems between rooms are fixed.
-Fixed the platforms in the final zone that could leave the player stuck.
-Fixed the rooms where the music stopped playing.

I hope these changes allow you to enjoy the game more and I offer an apology to those players who were affected by any of these errors.

notes.title: SECOND IMPORTANT UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hi! I've been working on an update to the game to include more features. It is now available in case you want to try it out or if you don't have the game yet, that you can enjoy a better version.

List of changes:

-Compatibility with crosshead on Xbox controllers.
-Fixed bug with the A button on the controls in the main menu.
-New resolutions in windowed mode
-Minor bugs fixed

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43688155/877d33d8b7ee9d5f2d6190c519afe2bbdc94bbe6.png[/img]

notes.notes:
Hello! Maybe some of you don't know it but for Steam to give a note to the games you must reach 10 reviews from people who bought it, at the moment Dystobel has 4, so if you bought the game and you liked it I would ask you if you can leave me a positive review, it would be very useful!

notes.title: 700 wishlists!
notes.notes: I hadn't mentioned it before but for the launch we surpassed 700 wishlists! Thank you very much for your support! Remember that if you want to buy the game and support me it's already available.

notes.title: First Major Update!
notes.notes:
I have read and seen a lot of feedback since the release, thank you all for your comments, these are some of the changes coming with this update:
-Default controls for XBOX controller are changed, (Yes, you can now jump with the A button!).
-A quick exit from the Electric Tower is added.
-Fixed a bug in one of the exits of the Electric Tower.
-Adjusted the difficulty of some bosses.
-Adjusted the hitbox of several objects in the game.
-Other minor corrections.

Thank you very much for the support received these days with the game! Remember that if you like it you can share it with friends or acquaintances to make it known to more people.

notes.title: Demo update
notes.notes:
Hello!

I have received feedback about the game, I applied several changes that you will see in the final version and that are already available in the demo, these are:

-Solved the controller compatibility bug in the pause menus.
-Adjusted sounds of some enemies
-The physics of the fire attack were modified to make it more versatile.
-Enemy difficulty has been adjusted and reduced.

I invite you to keep commenting to improve Dystobel.

Thank you very much to all who help me with feedback!
